newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed 42 Kurd rebels in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed 42 Kurd rebels in clashes.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 42 Kurdish guerrillas in clashes on Tuesday in the mountainous east of the country, military officials said.
They said the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels were killed in an operation backed by helicopters in Tunceli province.
One soldier was killed and one was injured in the fighting, they said.
More than 22,000 people have died in the PKK's 12-year fight for self-rule in the southeast of the country.
